bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
docker exec debug-ai-debug-ai-1 node -e 'let a;try{const e=process.env;const urls={coder:e.DEBUG_AI_CORE_GATE_CODER_URL,qwen3:e.DEBUG_AI_CORE_GATE_QWEN3_URL,granite:e.DEBUG_AI_CORE_GATE_GRANITE_URL,ministral:e.DEBUG_AI_CORE_GATE_MINISTRAL_URL};a=require("/app/server/adapters/ai-core.js").createAiCoreAdapter({baseUrl:e.DEBUG_AI_CORE_URL,apiKey:e.AI_CORE_API_KEY,modelGateBaseUrls:urls,dispatchMode:"model_gates"})}catch(e){process.exit(e.code==="AI_CORE_GATE_CONFIG_INVALID"?11:e.code==="AI_CORE_URL_REQUIRED"?12:e.code==="AI_CORE_API_KEY_REQUIRED"?13:14)};(async()=>{for(const [i,r] of ["code_scout","causal_scout","researcher","local_reviewer"].entries()){try{await a.preflightRoleGate(r,{probeTimeoutMs:3000})}catch(e){const c=String(e.code||"");process.exit((c==="AI_CORE_GATE_UNREACHABLE"||c==="AI_CORE_GATE_PREFLIGHT_TIMEOUT"?20:c==="AI_CORE_GATE_HTTP"?30:c==="AI_CORE_GATE_MODEL_MISMATCH"?40:50)+i)}}process.exit(0)})().catch(()=>process.exit(79))'
